newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian '96 budget shortfall due slowdown - minister.
newsitem.headline: Belgian '96 budget shortfall due slowdown - minister.

text.p: Belgium will fail to reach its 1996 deficit target because of an unexpected slowdown in the economy, the Belgian Budget Minister said on Tuesday.
"Like all European governments, we are suffering the negative consequences of the weak economy, which weighs on fiscal receipts," Van Rompuy told a news conference in reply to a question.
In a document about the 1997 budget, the Belgian government for the first time said that the 1996 budget is estimated to fall to 3.3 percent in 1996 from 4.1 percent in 1995.
The 1996 budget deficit target was 3.0 percent.
"Our 1996 deficit ratio is still better than that of neighbouring countries," Van Rompuy added.
